about: PostHog's channel definitions: for a campaign source (also used for a referring domain) or medium, the channel it means when the visit was paid and when it was not. Converted from PostHog/posthog posthog/models/channel_type/channel_definitions.json at commit 2a7c8be6e0a359d6e4f2143079a3972a90862383 (MIT licence; THIRD_PARTY.md): each row [domain, kind, domain_type, type_if_paid, type_if_organic, is_mobile_app] became source[domain] or medium[domain] = [type_if_paid, type_if_organic]; the domain type and the mobile-app flag, which the channel rules do not read, and rows with neither type were left out. web_channel.py reads it.
